lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the Telluride Hospital District board meeting on August 27, where directors take up a possible action on a Two Site Model for the new medical facility — a decision that will shape what gets built and where for generations. Also worth your attention: Town Council sits down September 1 to review proposals for a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies, and TMVOA votes to form a Workforce Housing Committee over in Mountain Village. Sprinkled through the week are Camp Alderwild, a talk on the Colorado River and Lake Powell, and the usual market and tennis rounds.

notable.stake: Board may vote on Two Site Model shaping the new hospital's location and scale.
TMVOA votes to form Workforce Housing Committee and adopt updated association policies.
Council reviews third-party audit proposals for Town rental housing policies — open work session.
